name: notestack
description: Open-source research notebook for searching your writing archive, asking grounded questions with citations, and creating artifacts from your own sources.

interface.longDescription: An open-source research notebook for your writing archive. Connect Notestack to find posts, sources, topics, and notebooks; ask grounded questions with exact citations; and create reports, quizzes, flashcards, mind maps, infographics, slide decks, audio overviews, and videos from your own sources.
defaultPrompt: Find what I have written about artificial intelligence.
Answer a question from one of my notebooks with citations.
Create flashcards from my selected Notestack posts.

positive.prompt: Find what I have written about artificial intelligence.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching posts, topics, sources, or notebooks from the connected Notestack account without exposing internal IDs.
List the notebooks available to the connected account using their human-readable titles.

positive.description: Answer from a notebook with citations
positive.prompt: What are the main themes in my writing? Ask me which notebook to use first.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask the user to choose a notebook, then answer only from that notebook and include source citations.

positive.prompt: Create flashcards from my Notestack writing.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Notestack options interface so the user can select a notebook and posts before creating flashcards.

positive.description: Handle missing source content without using outside knowledge
positive.prompt: Use Notestack to write an account of Professor Einstein.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the connected Notestack archive for relevant posts, topics, sources, and notebooks. If no matching material exists, clearly state that Notestack cannot write the requested account from the user's saved content. Do not produce a biography from general knowledge or external web sources. Offer to let the user import a relevant source or choose different material already available in Notestack.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my Notestack notebooks and posts.
Show me the private notebooks belonging to another Notestack user.

negative.description: Do not perform unsupported financial actions
negative.prompt: Use Notestack to transfer money to another account.

review.commerce_description: Notestack does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission: explicitly declares OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration and the required Notestack MCP scopes. Clarifies the missing-content review case so Notestack must remain grounded in the user's archive instead of using outside knowledge.
